custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে।

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ১) I helped a girl who was vulnerable. (Make it simple)
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option2: I helped a girl despise of she was vulnerable.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option3: I helped a girl in need of vulnerable.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Complex: I helped a girl who was vulnerable. 
Simple: I helped a vulnerable girl.

• Complex to simple:
• অনেক সময় relative pronoun + adjective টি object এর পরে বসে। সেক্ষেত্রে Complex sentence কে Simple করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে subject বসে।
- verb বসে।
- article বসে।
- প্রদত্ত adjective টি বসে।
- object বসে।

• নিয়মানুযায়ী, Subject 'I' + verb 'helped' + article 'a' + প্রদত্ত adjective 'vulnerable' + object 'girl' বসেছে।

Source: Advanced Learner's by Chowdhury & Hossain.

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ২) Select the correctly spelled word.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• The correct spelling is - Souvenir. (অপশন 'ক')

• Souvenir (noun)
English Meaning: something you buy or keep to help you remember a holiday or special event.
Bangla Meaning: স্মৃতিচিহ্ন।

Example Sentence:
- He bought a model of a red London bus as a souvenir of his trip to London.
- We brought back a few souvenirs from our holiday in Mexico.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ৩) Shahid was too fragile to stroll. (Make it compound)
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option1: Shahid was so fragile and could not stroll.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option2: Shahid was very fragile so could not stroll.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option3: Shahid was very fragile and cannot stroll.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option4: Shahid was very fragile and could not stroll.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Simple to Compound:
• Simple sentence এ too + adjective + to + verb থাকলে Compound এ too এর স্থলে very এবং that এর স্থলে and বসে।

- Simple sentence: Shahid was too fragile to stroll.
- Compound sentence: Shahid was very fragile and could not stroll.

এখানে,
- fragile (adjective) - ভঙ্গুর; ঠুনকো; পলকা; ক্ষণভঙ্গুর; নশ্বর; নাজুক।
- stroll (verb) - ধীরেসুস্থে ভ্রমণ; পায়চারি; ইতস্তত ভ্রমণ; পদচারণ।

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ৪) The antonym of 'Talisman' is -
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Talisman (noun)
English Meaning: An object that is thought to have magic powers and to bring good luck.
Bangla Meaning: সৌভাগ্যবহ বলে বিবেচিত কোনো কিছু; কবচ; তাবিজ।

Synonyms: Amulet (তাবিজ), Charm (আকর্ষণ), Good-luck piece (সৌভাগ্যর বস্তু), Periapt (মাদুলী), Phylactery (জাদুর বাক্স)।

Antonyms: Curse (অভিশাপ), Evil fortune (দূর্ভাগ্য বয়ে আনে বলে বলে বিশ্বাস করা), Hoodoo (দূর্ভাগ্য আনয়নকারী ব্যক্তি), Jinx (অভিশপ্ত জিনিস)।

Example Sentence:
1. He looked down and saw the phoenix talisman that he had found on the ocean floor.
2. Merle was surprised and thrilled to hold Lefty’s guitar in his own hands — a trophy, a torch, a talisman.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ৫) The robbed car was found. (Make it complex)
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option1: The car which was robbed is being found.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option2: The car which was robbed was found.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option3: The car which was robbed has been found.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option4: The car which is robbed was found.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Subject এর পরের verb টি past participle হলে Simple sentence কে Complex করার নিয়ম:
- Subject বসে।
- relative pronoun (who, which, that) বসে।
- tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- প্রদত্ত past participle থেকে sentence এর বাকি অংশ বসে।

Simple: The robbed car was found.
Complex: The car which was robbed was found.

Source: Advanced Learner's by Chowdhury & Hossain.

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ৬) What does the idiom "the status quo" refer to?
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• The idiom "the status quo" refers to - The existing state or condition.

• The status quo
English Meaning: the present situation / the existing state of affairs.
Bangla Meaning: বর্তমান অবস্থা।

Ex. Sentence: Certain people always want to maintain the status quo.
Bangla Meaning: কিছু মানুষ সবসময়ই তার বর্তমান অবস্থা বলবৎ রাখতে চায়।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ৭) No other predicament is as bad as this emergency. (Make it comparative)
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option1: This emergency is worst than most other predicaments.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option2: This emergency is worse than any other predicament.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option3: This emergency is worser than most other predicaments.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option4: This emergency is worser than all other predicaments.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
- Positive: No other predicament is as bad as this emergency.
- Comparative: This emergency is worse than any other predicament.
- এখানে, predicament (noun) - দশা; দুর্দশা; বিপাক।

• Degree এর নিয়মানুযায়ী, 
- Positive - Bad (খারাপ; মন্দ; গর্হিত; পাপ; কদর্য; অন্যায়)।
- Comparative - Worse (অধিকতর মন্দ; দ্বিতীয় আর একটি বস্তু বা বিষয়ে অপেক্ষা অপেক্ষাকৃত খারাপ বা নিকৃষ্ট)।
- Superlative - Worst ( চরম মন্দ অবস্থা; সর্বাপেক্ষা খারাপ অবস্থা; সর্বোচ্চ নিন্দনীয় পরিস্থিতি)।

আবার, 
• No other যুক্ত positive Degree কে Comparative Degree তে রুপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
- প্রদত্ত sentence এর শেষের subject + verb + positive degree এর comparative form + than any other + no other এর পর থেকে verb এর পূর্ব পর্যন্ত।
- Comparative degree তে সবচেয়ে বড় বুঝাতে than any other বা than all other ব্যবহৃত হয়। 
- Than all other এরপর plural noun বসে এবং than any other এর পর singular noun বসে।

Example:
Positive degree: No other wood burns as pretty as it.
Comparative degree: It burns prettier than any other wood.

• আবার, 
- Very few যুক্ত Positive Degree কে Comparative Degree-তে পরিণত করার নিয়ম -
- প্রথমে very few বাদ যাবে।
- Positive Degree এর Comparative form + than most other 
- এর পাশাপাশি Subject - Object এবং Object - Subject হয়ে বসবে।

• যেমন
- Positive: Very few books are as interesting as Harry Potter.
- Comparative: Harry Potter is the more interesting than most other books.

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ৮) What is the synonym of the word 'Strut'?
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Strut (Verb intransitive)
English Meaning: To walk with your chest pushed forward and your shoulders back to show you are proud.
Bangla Meaning: (strutted, strutting, struts) সদর্পে পদচারণ করা।

Synonyms: Swagger (সদম্ভে চলাফেরা), Parade (কুচকাওয়াজ করা), Stride (লম্বা লম্বা পা ফেলে চলা), Sashay (অহংকারীভাবে হাঁটা), Prance (বড় বড় পদক্ষেপে হাঁটা)।

Antonyms: Conceal (গোপন করা), Mask (মুখোশ), Disguise (ছদ্মবেশ ধারণ করা), Creep (হামাগুঁড়ি দিয়ে হাঁটা), Slink (ধীর এবং সতর্ক পদক্ষেপে হাঁটা)।

Example Sentence:
1. The boys strutted around like peacocks, showing off to some girls nearby.
2. Everyone was there to see Mary J. Blige strut the stage.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ৯) The word 'Travesty' means -
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option1: A distorted or grossly inferior imitation
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• The word 'Travesty' means - A distorted or grossly inferior imitation.

• Travesty (noun)
English Meaning: Travesty (of something) something that does not have the qualities or values that it should have, and as a result is often considered wrong or offensive.
Bangla Meaning: প্যারোডি; ব্যঙ্গাত্মক অনুকরণ; হাস্যকর রূপ।

Example Sentence:
1. The trial was a travesty of justice.
2. This travesty of Richardson's novel became the most frequently reprinted edition of the early 19th century.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ১০) Though she is impoverished, she is truthful. (Make it compound)
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option2: She is impoverished but she truthful.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Complex: Though she is impoverished, she is truthful.
• Compound: She is impoverished but truthful.

• Complex to compound sentence:

• Though/Although যুক্ত complex sentence কে compound sentence- এ পরিবর্তন করতে,
- but/yet ব্যবহার করতে হয়।
- অর্থাৎ দুইটা sentence- এর অর্থ যদি পরস্পর বিপরীত হয় তাহলে but/yet দ্বারা compound sentence করতে হয়।

- তাই নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর - She is impoverished but truthful.

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ১১) Which of the following is the correct spelling?
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• The correct spelling is - Trespass. (অপশন 'ঘ')

• Trespass (verb & noun)
English Meaning: to go onto someone's land or enter their building without permission.
Bangla Meaning: অবৈধ অনুপ্রবেশ করা ; অন্যায়ভাবে সীমালঙ্ঘন।

Example Sentence:
- I hope this is a public footpath and we're not trespassing on someone's land.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ১২) What does the word 'solicitous' mean?
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• The word 'solicitous' means - Caring.

• Solicitous (adjective)
English Meaning: Showing care and helpful attention to someone.
Bangla Meaning: (for/about/something/somebody); solicitous (to do something) (কারো কল্যাণ ইত্যাদির ব্যাপারে) উৎকণ্ঠিত, ব্যাকুল বা (কাউকে সাহায্য বা সেবা করার জন্য) ব্যগ্র/উদগ্রীব; solicitous to please.

Example Sentence:
1. He is always solicitous for his comfort.
2. She is solicitous about her health.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৩) Emma is one of the sharpest students in the class. (Make it positive)
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option1: Very few students in the class are as sharp as Emma.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option2: No other students in the class are as sharp as Emma.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option3: No other student in the class are as sharp as Emma.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option4: Very few student in the class are as sharp as Emma.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
- Superlative: Emma is one of the sharpest students in the class.
- Positive: Very few students in the class are as sharp as Emma.

• Superlative to positive:
- Structure: Very few+ positive degree এর পরের Plural Noun + Plural Verb+ as/so + Positive Degree+ as +Subject of Positive Degree.

• Superlative কে positive করতে হলে চারটি কাজ করতে হয়:
1. Subject- Object হয়, Object - Subject হয়।
2. Affirmative -Negative হয়, Negative Affirmative হয়।
3. Degree change হয়।
4. Indicator Change হয় (as... as/ so....as --> than).

• One of the যুক্ত Superlative Degree কে Positive Degree তে রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে very few বসে।
- superlative degree এর পরের অংশ বসে।
- verb এর plural form বসে।
- so বসে।
- Superlative degree এর positive from বসে।
- as বসে।
- প্রদত্ত sentence এর Subject বসে।

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৪) What does the term 'scapegoat' mean?
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option3: A person who takes the blame for others
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option4: A type of animal used for sacrifice
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• The term 'scapegoat' means - A person who takes the blame for others.

• Scapegoat
English Meaning: a person who is blamed for something that someone else has done.
Bangla Meaning: বলির পাঠা।

Ex. Sentence: The captain was made a scapegoat for the team's failure.
Bangla Meaning: দলের ব্যর্থতার জন্য ক্যাপ্টেনকে বলির পাঠা বানানো হলো।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

DPE-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৫) They knew him to be a burglar. (Make it complex)
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option1: They knew that he was a burglar.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option2: They knew that he is a burglar.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option3: They know that he has been a burglar.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.option4: They know that he was a burglar.
DPE-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Subject + Verb + Object + to be +…যুক্ত simple sentence কে complex sentence এ রূপান্তর করতে হলে,
- Subject বসে,
- verb বসে,
- that বসে,
- object এর subject রূপ বসে এবং 
- tense ও person অনুযায়ী auxiliary Verb বসে।
- adjective বসে।

Simple: They knew him to be a burglar.
Complex: They knew that he was a burglar.

এখানে, 
- burglar (noun) - সিঁধেল চোর।
